prs.author: felixweinberger

Both PRs have unknown CI status and touch the same number of files (3), so the first three tiebreakers (CI, tests, diff size) cannot differentiate them from the available metadata. That leaves the final criterion — oldest — which resolves to #1827 (PR number 1827 vs 2124, a gap of ~300 PRs indicating it was opened significantly earlier).

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 makes the same regex fix (`replace(/\/+$/, '')`) in both sites as #2214, but also introduces a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper and corrects a downstream inconsistency in `shouldAttemptFallback`: after normalization a root path becomes `''`, not `'/'`, so #2214's unchanged `pathname === '/'` guard would never match and the root-fallback suppression would silently stop working. #2215 fixes that comparison too, making it a complete, consistent fix rather than a partial one.
